unauthorized.title: Access Denied
unauthorized.message: Your account does not have administrator privileges required to access this workspace.

overview.title: Workspace
overview.lead: Prepare lessons, follow processing jobs and manage AI providers.

source.title: Choose the right moment
source.description: Select one segment from YouTube. Check existing ranges and prepare its transcript.

review.title: Listen, edit and check
review.description: Refine the transcript, preview karaoke timing and review learning notes and activities.

publish.title: Ready for learners
publish.description: Publish the approved lesson. Its content and selected activities are then locked.

jobs.title: Processing jobs
jobs.description: Inspect progress, review a failure or cancel work.

providers.title: AI providers
providers.description: Manage provider credentials and inspect model routes.

authoring.title: Lesson authoring
authoring.description: Select a YouTube range, review its transcript and publish approved content.

jobs.title: Background Jobs
jobs.lead: Check progress, review failures and cancel work that is no longer needed.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this background job?
cancelDialog.description: Cancellation is cooperative. The worker will stop at a safe checkpoint and preserve durable job state.

aiSettings.title: AI settings
aiSettings.lead: Connect providers and choose models for each lesson preparation step.
aiSettings.modelNamesNote: Routes determine which model handles each preparation step.

fields.apiKeyPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep existing secret

aiSettings.encryptionNote: Provider keys stay on the server and are never returned to the browser.
aiSettings.providerHint: Select a provider to update its key or enable/disable the connection.
aiSettings.removed: API key removed and related routes disabled.
aiSettings.localHint: Qwen runs on your server without an API key. The AI server must run in local mode.
aiSettings.removeDescription: The API key will be removed and this provider's routes disabled. Lesson processing history is kept. You can reconnect later.
aiSettings.nlpHint: Language analysis runs on the server without an API key.

curriculum.title: Curriculum
curriculum.text: Build learning paths from references to Lesson, Grammar, TOEIC and future content types.

lexicon.title: Lexicon
lexicon.text: Global dictionary with provenance, missing-Vietnamese maintenance and lazy enrichment.

placeholders.boundary: This boundary is intentional; full domain-specific CRUD belongs to a later implementation slice rather than a fake starter screen.

lessonAuthoring.title: Create a YouTube lesson
lessonAuthoring.lead: Choose a segment, approve its transcript and timing, then review learning content before publication.
lessonAuthoring.overlap: This segment overlaps an existing lesson. You may continue.
lessonAuthoring.embedBlocked: This video cannot be embedded. Choose another source.
lessonAuthoring.invalidRange: Use valid mm:ss.mmm timecodes within the video, at most 10 minutes apart.
lessonAuthoring.published: Published. Content and selected activities are locked.
lessonAuthoring.preparing: The transcript is not ready yet. Job details above show preparation progress or errors.
lessonAuthoring.playerError: YouTube playback is unavailable. Check embedding permissions and your connection before approving timing.
lessonAuthoring.playerNote: Click a sentence to seek. Playback stays within the selected segment and skips excluded sentences.
lessonAuthoring.reviewTiming: Check the complete segment against the audio. Grouped ASR timing needs manual review and may need dedicated alignment.
lessonAuthoring.karaokeConfirmed: I played and checked this revision: text, karaoke timing and excluded ranges match the audio.
lessonAuthoring.transcriptNote: Save before approval. Split at the text cursor; merge adjacent sentences with the same usage. Lexical edits require new timing.
lessonAuthoring.splitCaret: Place the text cursor between two nonempty parts before splitting.
lessonAuthoring.unsaved: Unsaved changes. Approval and generation are paused until you save.
lessonAuthoring.generationGate: Approve the saved transcript and confirm karaoke review before generation.
lessonAuthoring.contentReviewed: I reviewed the translations, annotations and selected activity sentences for publication.
lessonAuthoring.conflict: The lesson changed or is locked. Keep your edits, then reload the latest revision before retrying.

labels.SHORT_SENTENCE: Very short sentence: check its context
labels.TIMING_ZERO_DURATION: A timing interval has no duration
labels.GROUPED_TIMING: Timing covers a group of words; check karaoke against the audio

sourceErrors.YOUTUBE_MEDIA_TOOL_DISABLED: Media acquisition is disabled. Enable it in the Core development environment and retry.
sourceErrors.YOUTUBE_MEDIA_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE: The Core media tools are unavailable. Check yt-dlp and FFmpeg, then retry.
sourceErrors.YOUTUBE_MEDIA_TIMEOUT: YouTube took too long to respond. Retry inspection.
sourceErrors.YOUTUBE_MEDIA_FAILED: This video could not be inspected. Check that it is public and available, then retry.
sourceErrors.generic: Could not inspect this YouTube source. Check the URL and service connection, then retry.

jobErrors.AI_CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED: The provider or model is not ready. Check the API key and AI routing.
jobErrors.AI_FREE_TOKEN_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: The content exceeds the free route budget. Choose a shorter range or fewer Learn sentences.
jobErrors.AUTHORING_VALIDATION_FAILED: The AI content did not match the transcript. Try generating the content again.
jobErrors.AI_OUTPUT_INCOMPLETE: The AI response was incomplete. Try again with fewer Learn sentences.
jobErrors.AI_HTTP_400: The provider rejected the processing request. Check the selected model and AI configuration.

lessonAuthoring.retryFromActions: Use the action bar below to retry this step.

login.access: Sign in to prepare and review learning content.

catalog.description: Organize content and continue where you left off.
catalog.noCategories: No categories yet. You can still create a lesson.
catalog.noChannels: Channels appear when new YouTube sources are inspected.
catalog.title: Title
catalog.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{title}}”? Shared media and source data will be kept.
catalog.visibilityHelp: New practice is unavailable while unlisted. Existing learning history is preserved.
catalog.metadataHelp: Presentation information can change without altering approved learning content.
catalog.channelSyncHelp: Refresh channel names and avatars from YouTube. Up to 50 channels per job.
catalog.categoryInUse: Remove assignments before deleting this category.
catalog.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page?
catalog.lockedHelp: Save changes and complete transcript and karaoke review before continuing.
catalog.waitForJob: Processing is in progress. You can inspect or cancel the job.
catalog.prepareNext: Prepare the transcript to start editing.
catalog.reviewTranscriptNext: Review and approve the saved transcript.
catalog.reviewTimingNext: Align the approved transcript and check its timing.
catalog.confirmKaraokeNext: Play the lesson and confirm the karaoke review.
catalog.generateNext: Generate the learning content after karaoke review.
catalog.reviewCandidatesNext: Review activities, save your selection and publish.

waveform.moveRange: Move selection across the full video
waveform.overviewHint: Drag either handle to trim the range. Drag the selection to move the whole range.
waveform.noWaveform: Select and confirm a range to prepare its waveform. No audio or AI work has started.
waveform.unprepared: The new range is not prepared. Confirm to load its waveform.
waveform.loadError: Unable to load waveform. Confirm the range to retry.
waveform.invalidRange: Use valid mm:ss.mmm timecodes within the video, at most 10 minutes apart.
waveform.alignmentRequired: Local alignment is required before karaoke approval while draft timing quality remains unverified.

sourceWorkspace.sourceHint: Paste a YouTube URL to open the source editor. No AI processing starts automatically.
